doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21

title: Freddie Keppard, Buddy Bolden and Lopez
summary: Asked about Keppard and Buddy Bolden, Jack knew of Bolden but never met him, and mentions a Lopez in a colored band playing in his time.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: such a string instrument as a violin. I see. Uh, Jack, one thing more I wanted to ask you. Uh, we read a great deal in the history of jazz and Freddie Kepper. Did you know him? I did. Uh, what about Buddy Bolden? Did you ever know him?
Well, I, I heard of Buddy Bolden, but, uh, I never knew him. But, uh, there was a man by the name of Lopez. He, uh, he was one,
one of the Polish colored bands, I think, was in the city. That's right. And, uh, it was during my time.
At that time, he was playing music, and I was playing music at the same time.
